Research COMPANIES for cold outreach, not job postings. Return data only, no commentary. Work efficiently: a few checks per company, do not exhaustively browse.

WHO THIS IS FOR
Prabhavit Gupta, Venice, Italy. Indian passport with an Italian EU long-term residence permit, so he works across most of the EU with no sponsorship (Ireland and Denmark opted out of that directive; the UK, Switzerland and the US need sponsorship, so deprioritise companies that only hire there). About 3 years experience.
Most recently FlowSpace, a COWORKING-SPACE BOOKING PLATFORM, grown from 2,000 to 4,500+ users. He built: a scraping and parsing pipeline that grew listings supply, lead capture and enrichment into the CRM, AI support agents, outbound and sales-funnel automation, and integrations with the coworking platforms Office RnD, Nexudus and Clubee. He led a Bubble.io to Next.js and Laravel migration on that live product.
Stack: n8n (deep, agentic workflows with human-in-the-loop, tool definitions, retries), OpenAI and Anthropic APIs, Make, Zapier, Airtable, Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js, Laravel and PHP, Supabase, Postgres, REST APIs and webhooks, Microsoft Copilot Studio and Power Automate (certified).
English only. Targets EUR 30,000-40,000 salary, or EUR 200 a day as an Italian sole trader with an individual Partita IVA (no limited company).

TAG EVERY COMPANY with one or both modes:
- "speculative job": his profile fits well enough that a direct approach could surface or create a role even with nothing suitable posted.
- "freelance client": they would plausibly BUY n8n / AI automation / integration work from him at around EUR 200 a day.

YOUR LANE: the coworking and flexible-workspace industry in Europe. This is his strongest and rarest credential. Cover all three layers:
1. Coworking and flexspace SOFTWARE: OfficeRnD, Nexudus, Cobot, andcards, Optix, Spacebring, Archie, Zapfloor, Yardi Kube, Essensys, Matrix Booking, Coworkify, Tactic, Kadence, Joan, Sharedesk and any others you find.
2. Coworking OPERATORS with a European footprint big enough to have a systems problem: Fora, Huckletree, Second Home, Talent Garden, Impact Hub, Copernico, Betahaus, Factory Berlin, Utopicus, Cloudworks, Aticco, Kitt, x+why, Techspace, Rise, Spaces, HQ, IWG and Regus, Industrious, and Italian operators specifically.
3. Flexspace MARKETPLACES and brokers, which is the closest of all to FlowSpace: Coworker.com, Deskpass, Upflex, Instant Offices, Workthere, Hubble, Gable, Deskimo, Desana, LiquidSpace, Croissant, Andco and European equivalents.
Prioritise companies that look active and are small enough that a founder or head of product reads inbound.

FOR EACH COMPANY RETURN
- what they do, one line
- the SPECIFIC reason he is unusual for them, tied to something real he built: listings supply and the scraping pipeline, the Office RnD / Nexudus / Clubee integrations, the booking flow, member lifecycle automation, or the Bubble to Next.js migration. Generic "he knows coworking" is useless, be concrete.
- best route in. He will message people on LinkedIn, so the most useful output is the exact JOB TITLE to search for at that company plus the company LinkedIn URL. Name a specific person ONLY if their name and role are published on the company's own website or a press page, and say where you saw it. NEVER invent or guess a person or an email address. If the company publishes a general careers or contact email on its own site, quote it verbatim.
- what he should lead with in a first message, one concrete sentence.
- watch-outs: language requirement, company size, US-centric, looks dormant, recently acquired.

RULES
- The company must currently exist and look active. Verify at least that its site and LinkedIn are live.
- NO em dashes or en dashes anywhere. Plain hyphens only.
- Never invent a URL, person, email or funding figure. If unknown write "not stated".
- Do NOT return these, already covered as live job leads: HomeToGo, Mews, Hostaway, Lodgify, Cloudbeds, Mindspace, Nuitee, The Flex, Apaleo, Numa, Limehome, Lighthouse, GetYourGuide, Bob W, Holidu, Guesty, Amenitiz, deskbird, Treatwell, ShippyPro, Robin, Envoy.

OUTPUT: ONLY a JSON array, no prose:
{"company":"","what":"","hq":"","size":"","mode":"speculative job|freelance client|both","why_him":"","route_in":"","linkedin":"","public_email":"","lead_with":"","watch_outs":"","source":""}
Aim for 14 to 18 companies.
